scientific_integrity: Exact source equation and classical Airy-zero asymptotics are acknowledged. Asymptotic global maximization proved analytically; numerical corroboration is limited and non-certifying.
scientific_limitations: Strong-detuning limit for an idealized unbounded spatial coupling; no finite-detuning uniqueness, rate, noise, or experimental claim. Priority not independently established.
title: Strong-detuning migration of maximal bound-state spacing in an optical oscillator
